questions.prompt: A reference has 10 words, with 2 substitutions, 1 deletion and 1 insertion. What is WER?
questions.explanation: WER is (substitutions + deletions + insertions) / reference words = 4 / 10.

questions.prompt: Only one digit in a part number is wrong. How should exact-match entity scoring count it?
options: The identifier is correct because most digits match
Ignore it if sentence WER is low
questions.explanation: An exact-match identifier must match every character. A nearly correct identifier can still select the wrong part.

questions.prompt: How do you isolate the effect of added noise?
options: Use different speakers for every noise setting
Change the transcript policy with the noise
Score clean and noisy versions of the same held-out examples
questions.explanation: Paired examples keep the source speech fixed, making the channel change easier to interpret.
